QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Should I Leave?
QuestInfo.0: #b#m310000000##k's average resident #b#p2152011##k seems to have something on her mind.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152011# says she loves her home, but doesn't know if she can live in a town that is being conquered by the Black Wings any longer. She says the #o2150000# came and stole her water last night. First, eliminate the #r#o2150000##k to calm #p2152011# down.\n\n#o2150000##r #a239181##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated all the #o2150000#s, which seemed to calm #p2152011# down. She said she could never leave the town that she loves so much.

0.0: I was born in Edelstein and I've always lived in Edelstein. Sure, I've traveled to a bit, but I've never been away from home for more than a few days. But since the Black Wings took over, this place no longer feels like home.
0.1: Strangers, always watching... The lack of resources... The mysterious disappearances of close neighbors... Why, just last night, a #o2150000# ventured into my house! This town has really disintegrated. I don't know how much longer I can endure it. Please, help us!

yes.0: I want our town to return to the way it used to be even if just a little. Please defeat #r30 #o2150000# enemies#k. That won't do much in terms of hurting the Black Wings but still... It is something...

no.0: Is there no one that will help us? What will happen to Edelstein...

1.0: Have you defeated all the #o2150000# enemies? Thank you so much. Edelstein still hasn't returned to it's former glory, but still, it's something.

yes.0: I still love this town. I just can't bring myself to leave. The Black Wings can't be in power forever... I think I'll just wait it out.

mob.0: Have you not defeated #r30 #o2150000# enemies#k yet? I was hoping that the town would be a bit safer with those guys gone but... You should be able find them at the #b#m310030200##k.
